inventory.explanation: Native executable construction validates the frozen compiler root plus 30 body definitions, one foreign declaration and eight datatypes in its trusted IO/opaque-Run bridge. Clean TS execution validates the root alone. Native runtime and emitted-JS runtime consume the same frozen 18-module input closure; native build inventory is not its runtime checker event count.

measurement.cachePolicy: Fresh process and output for each run; frozen source bytes; ordinary OS filesystem caches, no cache flush. Native executable is reused, not rebuilt in root-to-JS timing.
measurement.timingScope: Pipeline wall includes module startup/load plus clean parse/expand/check/emit. Output publication/hash and post-run pin verification appear in total/guardian wall. Native phases are native child RUSAGE_SELF; TS/JS phases are Node process-wide CPU, not child CPU. TS book_load combines load/parse/expand; no fabricated split.

overhead.scope: One instrumented run compared to three clean controls; observed difference is not a causal per-sample overhead model.

limitations: Attribution is symbol-level only: the accepted image has no __DWARF segments (see child.machO.dwarfSegments), so sample cannot report source lines, inlined frames or variables.

Sample counts are sampled thread stacks (including blocked/sleeping threads) at a nominal 1-ms run-time interval; they are not CPU time and must not be rescaled to hostElapsedMs or treated as CPU shares.

Per-thread totals are separate sample populations. Only the main-thread subtree is the compiler compute thread for --threads 1; other threads are runtime threads and may be blocked. waitingSamples counts only conservative wait primitives; nonWaitingSamples is not CPU.
No allocation attribution: this helper observes stacks only. Per-object allocation or byte attribution would require a separately instrumented diagnostic rebuild and is explicitly not claimed here.
External sampling suspends the target per sample; the resulting slowdown of the check span is not measured by an A/B run, so hostElapsedMs and host CPU are perturbed by an unknown amount.
Only the check window is sampled. Parse, expand, emit and fixedpoint comparison are outside the sample window.
sample reports physical footprint at its own attach/report time; that is not an allocation measure and not a phase peak.
The sampler attaches by pid to the child this helper spawned; if attach failed, status is profile_incomplete rather than a silent fallback.

topSelfCoverage.categories: Categories use the complete raw sample, not the truncated top-self display.

conclusion.bottleneck: The native check phase dominates. Same native image has out-of-line tiny runtime accessors: term_triv/peek/aux/loc/rfc/tag contribute 32710 of 110413 sampled main-thread self stacks. The host INLINE macro is static inline without always_inline, while the pre-split pipeline runs only mem2reg and always-inline. Target a bounded mandatory-inlining policy for tiny accessors; do not blanket-inline spin or loop bodies.
notClaimed: Sample share is not time saved or CPU time.
Allocator/release categories do not count allocated bytes or temporary products; inlined/caller-blended work remains unresolved.
A split-O2 speedup is not inferred; g20 remains rejected.
This measurement changes no compiler and establishes no new fixedpoint.
